svg.aria-label: Isometric drawing of Ontomark as a sorting machine. Note cards in a tray pass a gate that admits only typed frontmatter, an indexing drum (Rust compiled to WebAssembly) builds the model, a reasoner gearbox derives inferred relations, and three readouts show the graph (asserted solid, inferred dashed), a four-drawer panel and a SPARQL selector. A diff window with an Apply lever writes reviewed edits back to the notes. An optional, off-by-default ingest module with a grounding stamp and a withheld tray feeds the same diff window.
svg.title: Ontomark anatomy
svg.text: HOW A NOTE BECOMES AN ONTOLOGY
resolve by label, alias or note
Apply; refused if the note changed
off by default; nothing is sent
